source_snapshot.items: GFX Stress - AGFHC GFX Stress Workload
source_snapshot.procedure: Run AGFHC gfx_lvl1; source notes gfx_lvl2/3/4 as higher-stress alternatives.
source_snapshot.criteria: AGFHC_SUCCESS [0] and no new relevant dmesg content; nonzero summary return is FAIL.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL insecure gfx_lvl1 tee only; no level ownership, independent monitoring, log delta or recovery.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires owner-locked level/duration, dedicated SUT, full monitoring and baseline-preserving errors.

old_problem: gfx_lvl1 through gfx_lvl4 differ in stress/coverage, but the source does not authorize a selection or duration. `No dmesg content` conflicts with log clearing and lacks an error policy. DeepSeek runs the nominal command without independent GPU/RAS/thermal/power observability or failure recovery.
disposition_reason: The default gfx_lvl1 intent and success/nonzero criteria are clear; exact level/duration/tool and error policy are Project Configuration. No automatic escalation to lvl2/3/4 is allowed. A dedicated authorized run must combine full AGFHC output with timestamped kernel/RAS/BMC deltas and independent GPU/thermal/power monitoring, preserving logs and stopping without retry.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2061, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2062 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00016-V002 / bbd9aff7e98a4a13 was directly read from XLSX.
gfx levels are not interchangeable; one signed level and full duration are fixed before execution, with gfx_lvl1 retained as source default.
AGFHC_SUCCESS [0] is necessary but not sufficient because GPU loss, RAS/kernel/BMC errors or thermal/power faults can occur silently.
Relevant error acceptance uses immutable baseline-to-test-window deltas rather than emptying dmesg or clearing historical evidence.
Independent monitoring begins before stress and any gap invalidates observability; no competing GPU workload is allowed.
No AGFHC run, GFX stress, login, monitoring, log clear, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Owner-locked AGFHC GFX stress with independent health and error-window validation
test_case.purpose: Run one explicitly approved AGFHC gfx level for its full duration on the mapped GPUs and prove AGFHC success plus zero disallowed test-window GPU/RAS/kernel/BMC/thermal/power regression without silently escalating stress.
required_package: Exact row-2061 variant plus SUT/GPU/driver/firmware topology and health
Approved AGFHC binary/version/checksum, gfx_lvl1/2/3/4 semantics and exact selected level/duration
Documented success/nonzero/miscompare behavior and output schema
Dedicated no-load authorization, independent GPU/thermal/power monitoring, storage and console recovery
test_case.test_command: STRESS-GATED; preserve logs and capture immutable GPU identity, AGFHC, kernel/RAS/BMC, thermal and power baseline. Verify the owner-selected gfx level/duration; never escalate from gfx_lvl1 implicitly. Start independent identity-bound monitoring and prove no competing load. After authorization run the exact recipe once, retaining complete stdout/stderr separately, exit/status/timestamps and monitor streams. Compare relevant log/RAS deltas and post-GPU health. Stop on monitor loss, nonzero return, GPU/error/thermal/power fault; no clear or rerun.
test_case.expected_result: The exact approved gfx recipe completes its full duration with AGFHC_SUCCESS [0], no miscompare or nonzero status, all mapped GPUs remain healthy, and no policy-defined new kernel/RAS/APEI/BMC error, thermal or power violation occurs with complete monitoring.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved tool/level/duration, full AGFHC and independent monitor evidence, success code and zero disallowed health/log delta. FAIL on nonzero/Status FAIL/miscompare, monitor gap, GPU loss, new disallowed error or thermal/power abort. Missing level/duration/policy/approval is NOT READY; process success alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Heavy GFX stress requires explicit selected-level authorization, dedicated SUT and no competing GPU load.
Do not silently escalate above the approved level or shorten duration.
Monitor GPU/RAS/kernel/BMC/thermal/power continuously and stop on first invalid state.
Preserve logs; no clearing, insecure access, automatic rerun or retry.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and mapped GPU/tool identity
Signed level/duration/semantics/error policy and stress authorization
Complete AGFHC output/exit/status and independent monitor streams
Post-window error-delta and GPU/thermal/power health analysis
No-escalation/no-clear/no-rerun audit, recovery state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On failure, monitor loss, GPU loss or thermal/power/error fault, stop the active recipe and preserve all first-failure streams. Quiesce GFX work and use only approved GPU/service recovery under human control; do not escalate, rerun or clear evidence.

source_conflict.reason: An owner-locked level/duration and baseline-to-window health policy resolve the selectable-level and empty-dmesg ambiguity while retaining exact GFX coverage.

blocked.reason: The stress method, evidence and recovery are complete; tool/level/duration/policy are supplyable runtime Project inputs.
